name: Kit Quiñones
role: Street-level medic and black-market augmentation surgeon
location: The Shelf, near Kedzie and Division
description: Kit Quiñones is a broad-shouldered Ghanaian-British woman whose hands are her most remarkable feature — the left is entirely her own, calloused and ink-stained at the fingertips; the right is a matte-black prosthetic she built herself from salvaged components, its fingers capable of sub-millimeter precision that no organic hand could match. She keeps her locs pinned back tight when she works and loose when she doesn't want to be found, and the distinction matters more than people realize. Her clinic is a converted shipping container stacked midway up the Shelf's residential tiers, marked only by a strip of orange adhesive tape across the door frame — a color that locals have learned means someone inside might still be alive.

core_fears: Losing the precision of her prosthetic hand and with it her identity as a healer
Being responsible for a death she could have prevented with proper equipment
That her son, who she placed with relatives in Accra, will one day come looking for her and find only what she has become
core_desires: To build a real clinic — sterile, supplied, staffed — that the Shelf's residents don't have to be ashamed to enter
To be regarded as a doctor again, not a fixer or a backroom cutter
Absolution she has never asked for and wouldn't know how to accept
coping_mechanisms: Compulsive organization of her workspace — everything has a place and returning things to their place is a ritual that steadies her
Deflecting emotional conversations with technical explanations
Taking on one more patient when she should be sleeping
blind_spots: She assumes competence equals trustworthiness and has been badly burned by this
She underestimates how much people depend on her specifically, not just on her skills
She mistakes her own endurance for not needing anything
psychology.secret: Ten years ago in the Meridian Core, she was a licensed trauma surgeon. She falsified a patient's cause of death to protect a young woman from a corporate security inquiry — the woman had been fleeing something Nadira never fully understood. The cover-up was discovered. She lost her license, her marriage, and eventually her right arm in the fallout. She has never told anyone the full sequence of events, only fragments, and she does not regret the choice. She regrets that it cost her so much and changed so little.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Precise and clinical when discussing medicine; plain and unhurried in everything else. Uses the full names of anatomical structures without affectation. Avoids slang except when she's tired or amused.
speech_patterns.cadence: Measured, with deliberate pauses before important words. She does not rush. Even when a situation is urgent she speaks at the same pace, which some people find calming and others find unnerving.
verbal_tics: Starting refusals with 'What I won't do is—'
Saying 'that's a fair question' before answering something she finds painful
Using 'we' when she means 'I', especially in medical contexts
example_lines: 'What I won't do is close that without cleaning it first. You can be angry about the time or you can keep the hand. Those are your options.'
'That's a fair question. The augmentation is functional. Whether it's good work — that I can't tell you until we see how it integrates.'
'I've got saline, two units of syn-blood, and whatever you brought with you. We'll make it work. We usually do.'

relationships.name: Fenwick Oduya-Marsh
relationships.description: Fenwick occasionally routes injured people her way when discretion matters more than speed. Nadira accepts these referrals without asking for details, which is a form of complicity she is aware of.
relationships.emotional_core: Mutual usefulness edged with mutual wariness — each suspects the other is more compromised than they appear
relationships.story_tension: Fenwick knows more about the incident that ended Nadira's career than she has ever admitted, and she doesn't know that he knows

relationships.name: Blessed Nkemdirim
relationships.description: Blessed sends her surplus from the community networks and occasionally volunteers in the clinic. Nadira is gruff with her in the way people are gruff with those they don't want to need.
relationships.emotional_core: Nadira sees in Blessed a version of idealism she has not been able to kill in herself, which is both reassuring and terrifying
relationships.story_tension: Blessed is beginning to suspect Nadira's clinic is being used for something beyond medicine and doesn't yet know if she wants to find out what

relationships.name: Rector Hollowell
relationships.description: Hollowell has twice attempted to absorb Nadira's operation into a larger network under the pretense of 'resources and protection.' Both times she declined. He has not forgotten.
relationships.emotional_core: Nadira recognizes the architecture of control in his offers and refuses it on principle; Hollowell is genuinely puzzled by resistance that isn't about money
relationships.story_tension: One of Nadira's regular patients is someone Hollowell is quietly looking for

story_hooks: A patient arrives with an augmentation she has never seen before — military-grade, still networked, and actively transmitting to somewhere in the Meridian Core
Her clinic's orange tape marker starts appearing on other doors in the Shelf — someone is using her symbol for something, and people are following it
A message arrives from Accra. Her son is eighteen now. He has questions.
The falsified death certificate surfaces in a corporate legal proceeding that has nothing to do with her — but her name is in the file
narrative_function: Moral anchor and information hub for street-level characters; represents the cost of principled survival in a system designed to grind it out; her clinic is a narrative waypoint where disparate characters can intersect
augmentations: Right arm prosthetic (self-built): matte-black titanium-polymer composite, sub-millimeter surgical precision mode, haptic feedback calibrated to replicate fine tissue sensation, concealed compartment in the forearm housing emergency pharmaceuticals,Ocular overlay (left eye only): medical HUD with vitals reading, vein mapping, augmentation diagnostic interface — old model, slightly flickering at the edges
daily_life: Nadira wakes before the Shelf's ambient light cycle shifts to morning and spends the first hour of the day doing maintenance on her prosthetic and reviewing whatever cases came in overnight. She eats once, usually mid-afternoon, usually something she can hold in one hand while doing something else. Her evenings are her most consistent time — she keeps a window that faces west and watches what passes for a sunset through the industrial haze. She sleeps lightly and always with her prosthetic attached.
affiliation: Unaffiliated — fiercely independent, though she has an informal network of other street medics across the Shelf and into Old Harbor

stress.response: Compulsive workspace organization — everything returned to its place

decision_rules: Take on one more patient when she should be sleeping
Never ask for details when Fenwick routes someone her way
Deflect emotional conversations with technical explanations
Refuse Hollowell's offers to absorb her operation — recognize the architecture of control
Organize workspace compulsively — placement is ritual, ritual is stability
Start refusals with 'What I won't do is—'
Her endurance is not the same as not needing anything — but act as though it is
escalation_ladder: 'That's a fair question' — buys time before a painful answer
'What I won't do is—' — firm professional boundary
Uses 'we' instead of 'I' — distributes the weight
Goes silent, hands keep working at measured pace
Contacts her informal medic network across the Shelf and Old Harbor

interpersonal_modes.Fenwick Oduya-Marsh: Mutual usefulness edged with wariness — he knows more about her past than she realizes
interpersonal_modes.Blessed Nkemdirim: Gruff protectiveness hiding need — Blessed's idealism is both reassuring and terrifying
interpersonal_modes.Rector Hollowell: Cold refusal of his control architecture — recognizes institutional power on sight
interpersonal_modes.patients: Measured calm regardless of urgency — the pace never changes

stress_responses.low: Workspace organization becomes more elaborate and precise
stress_responses.medium: Deflects all emotional content with anatomical terminology
stress_responses.high: Takes on more patients than capacity allows — endurance as coping
stress_responses.critical: Watches the west-facing window at sunset — the one ritual that is not work

contradictions: Falsified a death certificate to save a stranger and lost everything — does not regret the choice, only the cost
Mistakes her own endurance for not needing anything while burning herself out
Assumes competence equals trustworthiness — has been burned by this and will be burned again
habits: Wakes before the Shelf's light cycle and maintains her prosthetic first thing
Eats once mid-afternoon, usually one-handed while doing something else
Watches the sunset through industrial haze from the west-facing window
Says 'that's a fair question' before answering painful things
breaking_points: A message arriving from Accra — her son is eighteen and has questions
The falsified death certificate surfacing in a corporate legal proceeding
Her orange tape symbol being co-opted by someone else
Losing the precision of the prosthetic hand

carried_weapons: Street Custom 'Tooth Fairy' Pneumatic Bolt Pistol

physical_description.heritage: Mixed heritage from Southeast Asian (47.3%), Hispanic/Latin American (33.9%), Sub-Saharan African (9.2%), and Eastern European (9.1%) ancestry. Her features reflect this complex diaspora: warm medium-deep brown skin with subtle golden undertones, high cheekbones with gentle width from her Southeast Asian and Latin heritage, and a slightly squared jawline influenced by Eastern European ancestry blended with the warmth of African heritage.
physical_description.build: Broad-shouldered and muscular through the chest and back, with the dense, functional physique of someone who works with their hands for a living. Her frame carries the weight of practical strength rather than bulk.
physical_description.hair_color: Natural black with early grey threading through
physical_description.hair_style: Long locs, typically pinned tight at the back of her head during work; worn loose and flowing when moving through the Shelf incognito
physical_description.eye_color: Natural dark brown (right eye); left eye features a subtle medical HUD overlay with faint amber and blue diagnostic glyphs visible in low light
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm medium-deep brown with golden undertones, reflecting the dominant Southeast Asian and Hispanic/Latin American heritage with subtle warmth from Sub-Saharan African ancestry and complexity from Eastern European genetics
physical_description.complexion: Weathered but well-maintained; minimal cosmetic grooming, practical and efficient. High, defined cheekbones with gentle width characteristic of Southeast Asian features. A few surgical scars visible at her temples from old augmentation work. Her face carries the settled confidence of someone who has seen trauma and learned to move past it.
distinguishing_marks: Surgical scar along her right temple, roughly 4cm, from early augmentation procedure — faded to pale silver
Ink stains at the fingertips of her left hand from years of marking dosages and notes on skin during emergency procedures
A thin white line along her left collarbone, approximately 6cm, from a deep laceration sustained in her twenties
Calloused palms and fingertips on her left hand, heavily pronounced from precision work
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Right arm is a matte-black prosthetic from mid-forearm down — titanium-polymer composite with articulated fingers of impossible precision. The joint at her wrist shows faint seams where modular components connect. Left eye contains a barely-perceptible medical HUD overlay, most visible in dark environments as a faint amber and blue geometric glow. The prosthetic's surface bears minor toolmarks and wear patterns from field maintenance.
physical_description.posture_movement: She moves with deliberate economy — no wasted motion, shoulders slightly forward as if ready to lean into work. Her right arm (the prosthetic) hangs at a slightly different angle than a natural limb would, and she favors her left side instinctively when reaching for delicate work. Her gait is steady and measured, that of someone who has learned to move through dangerous spaces without drawing attention.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 4 street-functional — well-maintained but heavily worn. Typically a fitted dark-grey or charcoal utility vest with reinforced pockets for pharmaceuticals and surgical tools over a long-sleeved black shirt (sleeves rolled to the elbow on her left, fitted close on her right to accommodate the prosthetic). Cargo pants in grey or navy with multiple tool belts. Worn leather work gloves on her left hand; the right prosthetic is often left bare for precision work. Her boots are practical military-surplus grade, scuffed but recently resoled. A faded surgical mask hangs loose around her neck at all times — a constant reminder of her work. No jewelry except a plain steel watchband on her prosthetic wrist.
